fields.FIR_Description: It was alleged that the complainant lost a gold chain of about 5 sovereigns to a person who grabbed it near Sindhu Garden Residential Colony in Erode and ran. The matter was brought to Erode South PS on 2025-10-28, while the incident was placed on 2025-10-28 at roughly 16:40. Abirami Sekar approached Erode South PS to report the matter and can be reached on 9000000186. The complaint mentions Murugan Karuppasamy, who was reportedly contacted on 9000000309, in connection with the events. Potentially relevant material referenced includes CCTV footage and photographs. Records suggest a possible link with FIR-2026-00239, as the mobile number 9000000309 is associated with a suspect in both entries.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Suspect reportedly grabbed the chain and fled the spot quickly.
fields.Keywords: chain snatching, gold chain, residential colony, photograph, mobile number, CCTV, suspect, afternoon
